identity_checks.candidate_identity_method: Get-FileHash SHA256 of the original PNG file bytes
identity_checks.comparison_basis: Candidate logical 1x compared against reference physical 2x at the same logical proportion.

observations: The candidate is menu open, matching the required default state; the status row, two-line chapter header, progress area, chapter navigation and five reader tools are visible.
The header bottom and the 68-logical-pixel tool strip align with the reference at the same logical proportion. Chapter title, page counter and both chapter navigation labels fit without clipping.
The top-right table-of-contents icon has a roughly 18-logical-pixel list silhouette with three bullets and rules. The lower More tool shows three distinct dots.
The status time, Wi-Fi symbol, battery percentage and battery outline fit within the top band. White header and control surfaces have no visible shadow or stipple.
The visible artwork contains different panel scaling and page-internal white edges; these content differences do not establish an application viewport inset.
intentional_differences: The candidate uses its actual rendered artwork rather than requiring identical reference artwork pixels.

observations: The candidate contains artwork only. No status bar, menu header, notification, bookmark ribbon, chapter caption or page-counter footer is visible.
Artwork extends to the top and bottom capture boundaries; the narrow side white regions belong to the rendered page evidence and are not sufficient evidence of a viewport inset.
The reference includes a top-right bookmark ribbon and lower chapter/page labels, which are excluded by the explicit closed-reader override.
The candidate PNG is byte-identical to the reviewed fullscreen candidate, consistent with this reference-only footer alias resolving to the same artwork-only scene.
intentional_differences: The user explicitly overrides the reference footer and ribbon. The closed reader must remain artwork only.
The candidate uses actual rendered artwork whose internal panel geometry differs from the reference.

observations: The candidate is artwork only, with no visible ribbon, footer, notification, status area or reader tool overlay.
The artwork's line, halftone and black regions remain visible through the bottom of the capture. No separate bottom strip displaces the art.
The reference retains a bookmark ribbon, which is intentionally absent from the candidate under the closed-reader override.
The page-internal white side regions and different panel proportions are treated as artwork differences rather than a proven viewport defect.
intentional_differences: The persistent reference bookmark ribbon is absent under the explicit user override.
Actual candidate artwork is not required to match the reference artwork pixel for pixel.

observations: The picture panel shows a miniature of actual candidate artwork, five contrast positions with three filled segments, both contrast step buttons, five refresh choices, dither on and night mode off.
The refresh choice 6 is visibly selected with a black fill and white text. The dither and night switches have clearly different on/off knob positions.
The panel, progress area, chapter navigation and bottom tool strip fit within the viewport with no clipped controls. The picture tool is selected by a black top marker and bold label.
The header, title and approximately 18-logical-pixel bulleted table-of-contents icon remain visible. White panel surfaces have no visible shadow or decorative stipple.

The contrast minus/plus outlines are pale gray in the candidate while the reference outlines are black. The candidate Standard value is regular weight while the reference value is bold; see P3R1-REF08-1.
intentional_differences: The preview uses actual rendered candidate artwork rather than the reference's designed thumbnail.
The candidate explicitly labels the available software dither as 16-level grayscale dither. No separate hardware-dither option is visible, consistent with hardware_dither_qualified=false.

suggestions.description: The contrast controls lose the active-state emphasis shown in the reference.
suggestions.evidence: At the same logical proportion, the candidate minus and plus buttons beside the five contrast segments have pale-gray outlines, while the reference uses black outlines. The candidate Standard label is regular weight while the reference label is bold. The case metadata records contrast=0, so neither step direction is at a contrast endpoint.
suggestions.recommendation: Use black outlines for the enabled contrast minus/plus buttons and bold the Standard value to match the reference.

observations: The status time, Wi-Fi symbol, battery percentage and battery outline are visible, aligned within the status band and not clipped in both menu-open captures.
The More tool at the bottom right has three distinct horizontal dots in both captures.
This batch does not show the chapter tools targeted by the prior finding; no conclusion is made about that repair.
The top-right table-of-contents control uses a roughly 18-logical-pixel icon with bullets and three rules rather than an undersized three-line glyph.

limitations: This review covers only the four supplied reference pairs and does not establish a clean complete round.
All eight supplied PNGs were viewed directly with view_image. No additional image files or product source files were loaded.
The candidate identity is the SHA256 of original PNG bytes, not a decoded-pixel or perceptual hash.
Only existing PNG/JSON evidence and file identity were inspected. No local or remote application execution, build, test, smoke check or runtime probe was performed.
Static captures cannot establish functional reachability, absence of an invisible footer-cycle hit region, physical e-ink output, hardware dither behavior or control response.
The table-of-contents panel and its five rows are not open in these captures, so their row geometry is not reviewed here.
